senses.gloss: भूय n. The state of being, becoming, e.g. ब्रह्मभूय.

भूयस् (I) a. (f. सी) 1. More numerous, more abundnt; 2. greater, larger; 3. very great, तस्मिंस्तु भूयसीं वृद्धिं नभस्ये ता इवाययुः R.xvii.41; 4. abounding in, स्वकृतिमेवंप्रायगुणभूयसीमस्माकमर्पितवान् M.M.i., (compar. of बहु q.v.)

भूयस् (II) ind. 1. Very much, exceedingly, largely; 2. further moreover, again, भूयः स भूतेश्वरपार्श्ववर्ती (बभाषे) R.ii.46, Megh.ii.48, Bg.xiv.1; 3. frequently, repeatedly.(भूयसा is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) very much, in a high degree, for the most part, पश्चार्धेन प्रविष्टः शरपतनभयाद्भूयसा पूर्वकायम् Sak.i.; (2) generally, as a rule. भूयोभूयस् ‘again and again,’ भूयोभूयः सविधनगरीरथ्यया पर्यटंतम् M.M.i.)

भूयस् (I) a. (f. सी) 1. More numerous, more abundnt; 2. greater, larger; 3. very great, तस्मिंस्तु भूयसीं वृद्धिं नभस्ये ता इवाययुः R.xvii.41; 4. abounding in, स्वकृतिमेवंप्रायगुणभूयसीमस्माकमर्पितवान् M.M.i., (compar. of बहु q.v.)
भूयोदर्शन n. induction based on a multiplicity of examples.
भूयशस् ind. 1. Generally, as a rule; 2. very much, in a high degree; 3. again, further.

भूयिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) 1. Most abundant, most numerous; 2. most important; 3. very great, very much; 4. chiefly consisting of, mostly characterized by (generally at the end of a compound), e.g. अभिरूपभूयिष्ठा परिषद् Sak.i., R.iv.70; 5. nearly, almost (particularly after a past passive participle), निर्वाणभूयिष्ठमथास्य वीर्यं संधुक्षयंतीव वपुर्गुणेन K.S.iii.56, (super. of बहु q.v.).(भूयिष्ठम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) in the highest degree, very much, भूयिष्ठमासीदुपमेयकांतिर्मयूरपृष्ठाश्रयिणा गृहेन R.vi.4, xiii.14; (2) mostly, for the most part.)
